Some stations and part of the line will be underground in existing dense city environment and some will be in new city districts that are not yet developed. The line is expected to be built in stages. The first stage could open in 2035 and would consist approx. 8 km of line with 6-7 stations. The second stage is assumed to be inaugurated in 2045. As part of that operational robustness and reliable service is an essential. Not only does a good public transport network provide better mobility solutions in the city but greater use reduces the ’invested CO2’ per passenger km and therefore also a key aspect of sustainability. • Improve safety and working environment Everyone should be able to work without accidents or injuries, both in construction and operations of the new metro line. • A contribution to the city A new metroline should physically meet and connect with the city in a way that creates urban space quality and leave space for increased urban biodiversity. At the market dialogue Copenhagen Metro would like to discuss the following topics: • The use of digital tools (modelbased procurement) • Sustainability and experiences with carbon reductions and monitoring of carbon reductions during the construction New methods and materials for achieving the project goals. • Design and architectural finishes • Packaging of works • Health and Safety • Contractual issues Copenhagen Metro expects to conduct the dialogue meeting approx. during week 48 and 50, starting from the 25th of November 2025 and expectedly ending on the 13th of December 2025. The dialogue meeting can take place either as in-person meetings, TEAMS meetings or hybrid meetings.
